ablation_description: Ablation 5: GBM-specific LoRA adapter removed. Only the base Qwen2-7B-Instruct model and the general-purpose Llamole chemistry adapter are loaded and merged. The GBM domain adapter (Llamole-Qwen2-7B-Instruct-Adapter-gbm-with-graph-models) is NOT loaded. This tests whether the domain fine-tuning on GBM tasks provides specific benefits beyond general molecular generation capability.
